test_title: PYST 18: SSC MTS 2022 - English (Held On: 15 May, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank No. 4.
solution:
The correct answer is **"carried".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Carried" **means to transport something from one place to another.
 
• It is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank No. 4.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **"Deported" **means to expel someone from a country.
 
• **"Imported" **means to bring goods or services into a country from another country.
 
• **"Transported" **means to move something from one place to another, usually by vehicle.
